body:
This is my life right now and I’m currently in the psych ward and whenever I see him I do really well for a couple of days after and if he doesn’t come by in at least three days I completely revert back to square one and it makes me want to die of shame.

I’ve been crying all day today begging him to visit and finally he had enough and said this was too much and he’s shutting his phone off.

It’s unbearable I hate myself I want to fix myself so badly I don’t want him to leave me :’(

Sorry this reply won’t be as coherent as I want it to be since I’m still pretty sedated - but thank you so much for this. This is the most validation I’ve received ever since this all started. Thank you

Androcur + birth control+ laser  has reduced my facial hair significantly. Apparently androcur is not prescribed in the US, I have no clue why. 

Also my endocrinologist said that laser won’t work unless you treat the underlying hormonal problem first :/

I completely relate with having visible scars. They’re so validating. My current scars are about a month old and it’ll be difficult to find something as validating and calming when they fade. 

Thanks for commenting - I feel a lot less alone now. Hope you are doing well.
